title: Viva Insights: Consumption Dashboard shows Copilot Credit spend for Cowork and the Work IQ API
summary: The dashboard's access rules, licensing description and documented controls are supported. One billing clarification is needed: Cost Management shows operational credit usage, while Microsoft's billing comparison page directs financial reconciliation to the monthly billing record.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: At rollout and After rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft directs readers to the Microsoft 365 admin center for official charges, so finance should reconcile against Cost Management.
claims.quote: For official billing and detailed charges, visit the Microsoft 365 admin center for Copilot Credits or GitHub.com for GitHub AI credits.
claims.fix: Keep the dashboard-page attribution, but replace the finance advice with 'Use Cost Management for operational credit usage; reconcile financial totals against the monthly billing record, not usage dashboards.' In the checklist replace 'official charges are in Cost Management' with 'Cost Management shows operational credit usage, not an invoice', and replace reconciliation against Cost Management with reconciliation against the monthly billing record. The already-cited https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/implement/usage-based-billing-compare-dashboard-views says 'Everything in this view is expressed in Copilot Credits, not currency' and 'Use the monthly billing record for reconciliation, not the usage dashboards.'

claims.claim: Spending policies support monthly per-user credit limits.
claims.quote: Select monthly budget limits for users (optional). Use the toggle to select this option and to set a monthly limit for users to prevent a single person from spending all available credits.

claims.claim: Users hitting a limited policy budget lose access to agents and services until credits reset on the first of the month.
claims.quote: When users hit the limit, they lose access to agents and services for the rest of the month until credits reset on the first of the month.

claims.claim: Spending policies use prepaid credits before pay-as-you-go.
claims.quote: The policy always uses prepaid credits first, whether through capacity packs or through pre-purchase plans, before moving to pay-as-you-go.

claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant. ModuleId : VivaInsights; FeatureId : Viva Insights web app; Name : DisableFeatureForAll; IsFeatureEnabled : false; Everyone
